text:
maria: Quick sync — Optimize toolkit delivery status. Need short check on quant recommendations, batching/caching, and any regression alerts. Milestones: freeze quant recs by Thu EOD, docs PR by Fri, canary rollout Mon. Who owns what?

sam: I have quant recs for Llama-70B-q4. PR is open (<https://git.internal/r/redwood/optim-toolkit/pull/4231>). Perf: 1.9x throughput vs fp16, ~2% quality delta on eval set. Recommend profile `q4_onnx_fast` + fallback to `fp16` for latency-critical routes.

jake: Batching work in progress. Branch `dynamic-batching-v2`. Need to flip runtime flag `enable_dynamic_batch_v2` and increase max batch size from 32->48 for llm-chat routes. Question: can infra bump pool size by 2 nodes during canary?

anita: infra: cluster quota ok but node image needs the new CUDA libs. I can push the node pool image bump Tue 10:00 PT. Need an eng-runtime + eng-ml sign-off before we schedule the canary.

regression-bot: :warning: Regression alert: tokenizer drift on promptset `search_qc` — +6% response mismatch vs baseline for llm-70b. Flagged 45 examples. Details: <https://alerts.internal/rg/9876>.

sam: Noted. I'll run eval with `q4_onnx_fast` and `fp16` over that promptset by EOD tomorrow and post a short diff. If drift persists we revert to fp16 for the affected route.

liz: Product: FYI can we keep the canary to 5% traffic and telemetry retention 7d for rollout window? Need logs for promptset sampling.

kevin: I can reserve the Dedicated slots for Mon->Wed next week. Say 3x A100s?

maria: Good. Action items:
- sam: run drift eval + post diffs (due by 2041200000).
- anita: node image bump Tue 10:00 PT.
- jake: prepare runtime flag PR and testing steps.
- kevin: reserve 3x A100 canary -> confirm by EOD.
- liz: create sampling dashboard (shortlist of prompts) -> due Fri.

sam: ping @maria for a quick CR review on #4231 when you have a min. Two small comments left on quant table.

maria: On it, will review tonight. Left one comment about the rounding for per-token latency. :thumbsup:

jake: Quick caching suggestion — for autocomplete endpoints we should enable prefix KV cache with TTL 5m and rate-limit cache fills to avoid colder spikes. Example config:
```yaml
route: /autocomplete
cache:
  type: prefix_kv
  ttl: 300  # seconds
  max_fill_qps: 50
```
This should reduce p50 by ~30% in our perf tests.

anita: Note dependency: eng-sre needs to merge `k8s-psp-fix` before we can enable the new node image. Issue <https://git.internal/r/redwood/infra/issues/551>.

maria: OK, timeline recap: freeze quant recs Thu EOD -> sam posts results, docs PRs by Fri, canary Mon (5% traffic, 3x A100 reserved). If regression-bot still flags drift we fallback to fp16 for affected route.

liz: Sounds good — I'll add the canary dashboard and sampling list in the product doc.

kevin: Confirmed reservation.

maria: Thanks everyone — please update your PRs/issues with the tags `optkit-canary` and `optkit-quant-freeze`. We’ll reconvene async if any blocker pops up.

sam: copying results here once done.

regression-bot: :white_check_mark: Next automated scan scheduled in 12h.

maria: thanks — closing thread for now, ping me if anything blocks.
